perplexity.description:
Spooky Action" is the debut solo album by English singer-songwriter Paul Draper, released on 11 August 2017 through Kscope. Formerly the frontman of the band Mansun, Draper crafted this album over the course of more than a decade, drawing on material that had been set aside and later reworked alongside new compositions. The album blends elements of alternative rock, art rock, and synth-driven pop, marked by introspective lyrics, atmospheric production, and a polished yet adventurous sonic palette. Standout tracks such as "Don't Poke The Bear" and "Things People Want" showcase Draper's knack for melodic hooks and layered arrangements, reflecting both his post-progressive roots and his evolution as a solo artist.

Musically, "Spooky Action" stands as a significant milestone in Draper's career, bridging his legacy with Mansun and his new direction as a solo act. The album was well-received by critics, who praised its thoughtful songwriting and dynamic range. Commercially, it entered the UK Albums Chart at No. 19 and reached No. 3 on the UK Independent Albums Chart, affirming its impact within the rock genre. Released to coincide with a sold-out UK tour, "Spooky Action" established Draper as a compelling solo voice in the contemporary rock landscape.
